scope: Sensitivity of simulated switching to exploratory extraction assumptions. Not a validated prediction: the extraction is unqualified for plane holes and via arrays, the driver is behavioural, capacitor models are assumed, and gate-charge-dependent quantities carry the EPC2302 Fig. 7 exception.

input_manifest.taken_at: start of run, when the inputs were loaded

conditions.source: design round operating point (owner targets, 5 October 2026)

fixed_assumptions.measurement: ideal probe, Q2 drain terminal to Q2 source terminal

extraction_summary.definition: Variant G diagnostics: power-loop inductance at Q1 and the board common-source inductance of each FET.

gate_and_current_diagnostics.vgs_definition: q*_vgs: the vendor model's terminal gate-source voltage (gatein-sourcein), after any added package inductance; earlier notes called it 'die VGS'. It is not the internal channel-control voltage behind the model's rg (0.5 ohm) and rs (method audit, 1 October 2026); q*_vgs_internal (test 9, when saved) is.

terminals.device_metrics: vendor-model terminals (q1 vgs and vds for the energies, q2 gate-source peak)
terminals.switch_node_metrics: Q2 drain pad to circuit ground (Q2 source pad)
terminals.energies_exclude: energy stored in package or gate-loop inductors

metrics.not_validated: q1_eoff_J, q1_eon_J and the edge times depend on gate charge (EPC2302 Fig. 7 exception)

period_loss.scope: FET losses only (inductor, copper, capacitor and gate-drive losses excluded); for ranking
